Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 09:12:03 -0700
Subject: Request: sample onboarding artifacts for SIG review

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the quick sync this morning. As discussed, BluePeak's SIG/SOC2 team needs a small, downloadable bundle demonstrating your employee onboarding and offboarding controls for a recent hire cohort. To be precise, can you provide the following for a single, recent cohort (preferably hires from Sep–Oct 2026):

- A short CSV manifest listing cohort members (name, role, hire date) with PII redacted
- Redacted background-check summaries (sample of 10) with masking applied to personally identifying details
- Training completion export showing security & privacy module timestamps (CSV)
- Access provisioning and deprovisioning/log snapshot that covers first 90 days for the cohort

We need artifacts that are redacted but retain provenance (timestamps, reviewer initials, and hash or audit id). If you have an internal redaction process note or a short attestation statement we can include that too.

Target delivery for our reviewers is COB Friday (Nov 5) to keep the audit on schedule. If there are any constraints (air-gapped evidence, DLP restrictions) let me know up front and we can adjust.

Best,
Lena Park
Audit Manager, AuditPartner

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Hi Lena —

Thanks, we can assemble that. High-level plan:

1) Provide a CSV manifest with pseudo-IDs rather than real names and a mapping key held internally (we'll include a hash to prove integrity).
2) Deliver 10 redacted background summaries in PDF with our standard redaction mask applied (names/emails/SSNs removed) plus a short redaction log.
3) Export training completion for the cohort from our LMS (CSV) including module ids, completion timestamps, and version of the training content.
4) Pull access provisioning/deprovisioning events from our IAM audit logs (CSV slice) for the 90-day window.

I'll attach a sample manifest and the training CSV as a first pass. Nikhil will provide the background redactions and the deprovisioning log; Soojin, can you add a one-paragraph attestation about our redaction process?

We should be able to deliver the full bundle by EOD Nov 5. If BluePeak needs the files via secure ShareFile instead of Drive, flag it and I'll route accordingly.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: cohort-A_onboarding_manifest.csv (CSV), training_completion_oct2026.csv (CSV)
